actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_document_ai.description: Permanently delete a document and its file by ID.
actions.delete_document_ai.props.documen: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.
actions.download_document.description: Download a generated document as a file you can attach or upload in later steps.
actions.download_document.props.document: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.
actions.download_document.props.file_nam: Name for the downloaded file. Defaults to the document file name.
actions.generateDocument.description: Generates a new document using a specified template.
actions.generateDocument.props.meta.desc: Meta-Data to attach to the Document.
actions.generateDocument.props.payload.d: Data to use for the Document generation.
actions.generateDocument.props.status.de: Draft only saves the document; Pending generates the file right away.
actions.generateDocument.props.wait_for_: Generate now and wait (up to 7 minutes) until the file is ready, so the output has the download URL. Overrides Document Status.
actions.generate_document_ai.description: Generate a document from a template ID and wait for the finished file link.
actions.generate_document_ai.props.file_: Name of the generated file, e.g. "Invoice 2026-001.pdf". Stored as the _filename meta key.
Optional metadata to keep with the document, as a JSON object. It is returned with the document and in triggers.
actions.generate_document_ai.props.paylo: The data merged into the template, as a JSON object, e.g. {"clientName": "Jane Doe", "total": 120}.
actions.generate_document_ai.props.templ: The template ID (a UUID). Use List Templates to find it.
actions.generate_document_ai.props.wait_: Wait up to 4 minutes for the file and return its download URL; if it is not ready by then, return the document ID and current status.
actions.get_current_user.description: Get the connected PDFMonkey account, its plan and how many documents it can still generate.
actions.get_document_ai.description: Get a document's status, file name and download link by its ID.
actions.get_document_ai.props.document_i: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.
actions.get_template.description: Get a template with its HTML, test data and page settings.
actions.get_template.props.template_id.d: The template ID (a UUID). Use List Templates to find it.
actions.list_documents.description: List documents, newest first, filtered by template, status, file name or update date.
actions.list_documents.props.page.descri: Page number, starting at 1. Each page has up to 24 documents.
actions.list_documents.props.search.desc: A document ID (exact match) or part of a file name.
actions.list_documents.props.template_id: Only documents made from this template. Use List Templates to find the ID.
actions.list_documents.props.updated_sin: Only documents updated after this date and time.
actions.list_templates.description: List the document templates in your PDFMonkey workspaces.
actions.list_templates.props.workspace_i: Only templates of this workspace. Leave empty to list the templates of every workspace you can access.
actions.update_document.description: Change a document's data, metadata, file name or template, and optionally generate it again.
actions.update_document.props.document_i: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.
Name of the generated file, e.g. "Invoice 2026-001.pdf". Stored as the _filename meta key.
actions.update_document.props.generate.d: Queue the document for generation after the update (sets its status to pending).
actions.update_document.props.meta.descr: New metadata, as a JSON object. Replaces all meta keys. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_document.props.payload.de: New data for the document, as a JSON object. Replaces the whole payload. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_document.props.template_i: Switch the document to another template. Leave empty to keep the current one.
auth.description: Your PDFMonkey secret API key. In PDFMonkey, open [My Account](https://dashboard.pdfmonkey.io/account) and copy the API Secret Key.
description: Generate PDF documents from templates and JSON data.
triggers.documentGenerated.description: Triggers when a document generation completes successfully.
